items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Pete Deconja I think his name was. He didn't come. Wasn't going to be but two of us on trumpet. And he didn't show up.

ctx.x: What about when they're walking? Did you walk any special way?

Well, yeah. Sometime I'd get off step, you know, because I had a way of doing a lot of fingering, you know. And by me doing a lot of fingering, I'd misstep with the, you know, like, with the drum, you know. Boom, boom. It's important to walk right with the drum, you know. But now I'd be playing and, do I'd just step in, because I didn't make a misstep, you know, with the drum, I'd lift him all together. But now when they're playing in the funeral march, I used to walk right direct. I took a parade, y'all, one…
And I took that parade from nine and more until six and even.
